description: This file defines an interface AlertDAO that specifies database operations for managing Alert objects in the OpenMRS system, including saving, retrieving, deleting alerts, and fetching all alerts with optional filters.

classes.name: AlertDAO
classes.description: Interface defining data access methods for Alert objects in the AlertService

methods.name: saveAlert
methods.description: Persists an Alert object to the database, returning the saved Alert.

methods.name: getAlert
methods.description: Retrieves an Alert by its unique alertId.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Alerts for a specific user, with options to include read or voided alerts.

methods.name: deleteAlert
methods.description: Deletes a specific Alert from the database.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves all alerts, optionally including only non-expired ones.
